title: SatelliteEmissionsController.setMetaERC20SpokeOrHub: missing access control
description: In SatelliteEmissionsController.setMetaERC20SpokeOrHub (src/protocol/emissions/SatelliteEmissionsController.sol) the access control modifier onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) was removed, so any address can call this function.

title: TrustToken.mint: missing check
description: In TrustToken.mint (src/legacy/TrustToken.sol) the check "require(minterAmountMinted[msg.sender] + amount <= minterCap, "Minting cap exceeded for minter");" was removed, so the condition is no longer enforced.

title: VotingEscrow._withdraw: off-by-one in a boundary check
description: In VotingEscrow._withdraw (src/external/curve/VotingEscrow.sol) the comparison in "require(block.timestamp >= _locked.end, "The lock didn't expire");" was shifted by one (>= became > or <= became <), an off-by-one in a boundary check.

title: VotingEscrow.unlock: missing access control
description: In VotingEscrow.unlock (src/external/curve/VotingEscrow.sol) the access control modifier onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) was removed, so any address can call this function.
